name: ZOMBOY: I am Zombie
summary:
Play as a Zombie
Zomboy: I AM ZOMBIE puts you in the shoes of a real, live (well, undead) zombie. Shamble through a big open town full of people, missions and mayhem, and decide what kind of zombie you want to be. 
Open World
Explore a large, open city packed with streets, shops, rooftops and hidden corners. The whole town is your playground.
